🧟 If Zombies Were Coming…

Imagine the zombie apocalypse suddenly breaks out!
After fleeing for your life, you finally discover these
rooms that could serve as temporary shelters. 🏚️

If it were you, which room would you choose to
survive in? And why? 👀

🗓️ Event Period: Today – September 11

🎁 Rewards: 10 lucky players will be selected to
receive $4.99 worth of Gold Blocks!

📅 Rewards Sent: September 14

How to Participate:
🏠 Choose the room you’d be willing to live in.
💭 Tell us why you chose it.
📝 When submitting your answer, please include your
in-game name and Server ID.

🧟‍♂️ The zombies are coming… Which room will you
choose?
Choose wisely—you might just survive!
